statement: Add deterministic environment preparation and readiness verification so DevRelay can prove that the exact environment required for authorized work is safe, reproducible, correctly configured, and ready before execution proceeds.
objectives: Prepare and verify declared execution and verification environments before authorized work runs.
Keep environment capabilities modular, provider-neutral, replaceable, and capability-gated.
Detect environment drift and block invalid downstream execution.
Preserve exact redacted environment evidence and traceability without exposing secrets.
Operate through ChatGPT/Codex Desktop on Windows as the release-defining host.
constraints: Core owns routing, validation, gates, progression, checkpointing, and traceability authority.
Adapters cannot silently mutate global host state, expose secret values, or claim readiness authority.
Preparation effects require explicit capability grants and durable receipts.
The controlled release claims only ChatGPT/Codex Desktop on Windows.
Architecture and implementation remain blocked until adaptive requirements closure reaches 0.99.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact environment profile and repository revision determine one reproducible readiness decision.
Missing required capabilities, stale fingerprints, or unverifiable state block execution.
Exact replay does not repeat preparation effects.
Evidence records commands, versions, digests, outcomes, durations, and redactions without secret values.
A Windows Desktop dogfood prepares, verifies, resumes, detects drift, and fails closed.
assumptions: PM-001 ProjectMemory is the immutable upstream lifecycle baseline.
Routine in-scope gates and implementation changes have standing owner approval.
Unresolved product intent and trust-boundary choices still require explicit clarification.
